mapper.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT IDENT1_0 AS SupplierCategoryCode, TEXTE_0 AS SupplierCategoryName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'BPSCATEG' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'DESAXX'
AND ( ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = #{SupplierCategory} OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{SupplierCategory}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS SupplierTypeCode, TEXTE_0 AS SupplierTypeName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '40' -- type
AND ( ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0 = #{SupplierType} OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{SupplierType}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS SupplierSubTypeCode, TEXTE_0 AS SupplierSubTypeName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '41' -- sub type
AND ( ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0 = #{SupplierSubType} OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{SupplierSubType}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS SupplierGeoRegionCode, TEXTE_0 AS SupplierGeoRegionName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '42' -- category3 region, Asia, Europe, America, Africa, Middle East, Other
AND ( ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0 = #{SupplierGeoRegion} OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{SupplierGeoRegion}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPARTNER.BPRNAM_0 + IIF (BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1 = '', '', BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1) AS SupplierName FROM EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER BPARTNER ON BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 LIKE #{Supplier} + '%' OR UPPER(BPARTNER.BPRNAM_0) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{Supplier}) + '%' OR UPPER(BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{Supplier}) + '%' )
mapper.select: ORDER BY BPRNUM_0 ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

WITH T_BP_SUPPLIER_CATEGORY AS ( ), T_BP_SUPPLIER_TYPE AS ( ), T_BP_SUPPLIER_SUB_TYPE AS ( ), T_BP_SUPPLIER_GEO_REGION AS ( ), T_BP_COUNTRY AS ( ) SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPARTNER.BPRNAM_0 + IIF (BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1 = '', '', BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1) AS SupplierName, BPARTNER.BRRSHO_0 AS SupplierShortName, BPARTNER.ENAFLG_0 AS Enabled, T_BP_SUPPLIER_CATEGORY.SupplierCategoryCode AS SupplierCategoryCode, T_BP_SUPPLIER_CATEGORY.SupplierCategoryName AS SupplierCategoryName, T_BP_SUPPLIER_TYPE.SupplierTypeCode AS SupplierTypeCode, T_BP_SUPPLIER_TYPE.SupplierTypeName AS SupplierTypeName, T_BP_SUPPLIER_SUB_TYPE.SupplierSubTypeCode AS SupplierSubTypeCode, T_BP_SUPPLIER_SUB_TYPE.SupplierSubTypeName AS SupplierSubTypeName, T_BP_SUPPLIER_GEO_REGION.SupplierGeoRegionCode AS SupplierGeoRegionCode, T_BP_SUPPLIER_GEO_REGION.SupplierGeoRegionName AS SupplierGeoRegionName, T_BP_COUNTRY.CountryCode AS CountryCode, T_BP_COUNTRY.CountryName AS CountryName, BPADDRESS.POSCOD_0 AS PostalCode, BPADDRESS.SAT_0 AS UsStateCode, BPADDRESS.CTY_0 AS CityName, BPADDRESS.BPAADDLIG_0 AS Address0, BPADDRESS.BPAADDLIG_1 AS Address1, BPADDRESS.BPAADDLIG_2 AS Address2, BPADDRESS.TEL_0 AS Tel0, BPADDRESS.TEL_1 AS Tel1, BPADDRESS.TEL_2 AS Tel2, BPADDRESS.TEL_3 AS Tel3, BPADDRESS.TEL_4 AS Tel4, BPADDRESS.FAX_0 AS Fax0, BPADDRESS.MOB_0 AS Mobile0, BPADDRESS.WEB_0 AS Web0, BPADDRESS.WEB_1 AS Web1, BPADDRESS.WEB_2 AS Web2, BPADDRESS.WEB_3 AS Web3, BPADDRESS.WEB_4 AS Web4 FROM EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER BPARTNER ON BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 LEFT JOIN T_BP_SUPPLIER_CATEGORY ON BPSUPPLIER.BSGCOD_0 = T_BP_SUPPLIER_CATEGORY.SupplierCategoryCode LEFT JOIN T_BP_SUPPLIER_TYPE ON BPSUPPLIER.TSSCOD_0 = T_BP_SUPPLIER_TYPE.SupplierTypeCode LEFT JOIN T_BP_SUPPLIER_SUB_TYPE ON BPSUPPLIER.TSSCOD_1 = T_BP_SUPPLIER_SUB_TYPE.SupplierSubTypeCode LEFT JOIN T_BP_SUPPLIER_GEO_REGION ON BPSUPPLIER.TSSCOD_2 = T_BP_SUPPLIER_GEO_REGION.SupplierGeoRegionCode LEFT JOIN T_BP_COUNTRY ON BPADDRESS.CRY_0 = T_BP_COUNTRY.CountryCode LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.BPADDRESS BPADDRESS ON BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = BPADDRESS.BPANUM_0 AND BPADDRESS.BPAADDFLG_0 = 2 WHERE 1 = 1
AND BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = #{Supplier}
